blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate ruling that reduced the required number of votes in convicting or acquitting Vice President Sara Duterte is being challenged again in the Supreme Court, this time by her allies, Sens. Robinhood Padilla and Christopher “Bong” Go, and the political party of her father. The petition for certiorari and prohibition was filed by Padilla, Go, and Partido Demokratiko Pilipino Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban) before the Supreme Court on Sept. 29, a day before the high tribunal dismissed the three earlier petitions that also questioned the Senate ruling that lowered the required votes in the impeachment trial of […]...
